Triage: lands in area:ux · domain:server · Bug · p2 · pm:queue · size S; rationale: a shared cache can serve one caller's localized `404` message to a caller in another language. That is user-facing wrong-language text, and UX has no p3 for user-facing defects, so p3 → p2, the same grade as sibling #37811. Recorded 2026-11-27T06:20Z.

- Pins in the existing harness files; one `.changeset/*.md` (types, rest, hono, runtime patch, as PR #37813).
Seat ruling on scope: the language header is added whenever the answer carries a `userMessage`, at any status, with no table of cacheable statuses. Stop on breach and explain in the report.

Responsibility: every error answer that carries a localized `userMessage` varies on the request language, at all three exits, so a cache cannot hand one language's message to another. The new `@objectstack/types` export is a public widening, so TIER_DEFAULT review is owed.
Thread-read: none
Premise: holds, measured on a fresh showcase boot at origin/main 815e882b. A by-id miss answers 404 `RECORD_NOT_FOUND` with `userMessage` in en / zh-CN / ja-JP, and `Vary` is only `Origin, Accept-Encoding`. Full report: `/mnt/project-files/card-37828/pre-claim-report-815e882b.md`.
